name: mixmax-publishing-core
description: Shared GitHub Pages publishing foundation for all Mixmax revenue-reporting plugins (weekly, monthly, quarterly, leader updates). Provides a single-source-of-truth config for the GitHub PAT, repo, branch, Pages URL, and per-artifact path roots — so PAT rotations or repo migrations require editing one file. Required dependency for the Mixmax leader-update, sales-leader-weekly, and cs-leader-weekly plugins.
